title: just-deliver catalog policy
description: IT Ops layer. 'set' overrides any other layer, 'default' only fills gaps, 'require' makes a workload declare a component. At least one of the three is required. Unique by name across the catalog.

reason.description: Why the policy exists; shown to teams asking why a setting has its value.

match.description: Criteria the policy applies to: the requirement's type and class, the environment type, the kind (requirement or runtime), the runtime, and the template of a node.

environmentType.description: The environment's type, as the catalog declares it.

set.description: Config path -> value. Wins over every other layer.

default.description: Config path -> value, applied only where nothing else set the field.

require.description: A component every workload this policy matches must require (any id, any class); only with 'kind: runtime'. A policy never adds nodes.
